main_text.p: teretur. Formam & modum instruendi & indicendi talia Duella, qui scire volet, adeat TholosanumTholof. Syntag. jur. uni-verf.libr., qui omnia requisita satis accuratè delinea-vit.

Et quamvis in casubus jam48. cap. 16. enumeratis, non quidem adeò temerariè monomachia permissa videatur: modus tamen ille veritatem explorandi iniquus erat, ac consuetudo talis peccati nutritiva.Ut quæ non tantùm, civili canonico, sed & divino & naturali juri adver-saretur.

Et ut à posteriori jure ordi-ar, quid magis est contra natu-ralem rationem, quam facino-rosum extra poenam criminis constitui, innocentem puniri: quod tamen in duellis judici-alibus evenire, plus quàm notum est ? Quid magis contra omnem charitatem, quàm fu-riarum instar ad vulnera & cæ-

page.notes: Catchword "des." read at the foot right; it is the first word of the next page. The printed "nutritiva.Ut" has no space after the full stop; left as printed. Long s throughout rendered as plain s (e.g. "scire", "Tholosanum", "consuetudo"). The margin note "Tholof. Syntag. jur. uni-verf.libr." is set in four short lines in the margin; joined here. Some faint marks at the right margin and a bottom-right scan edge are not printed text and are omitted. Printed text is slightly blurred around "Tholosanum" and "adver-saretur", but readable.
